fields.title: 📖 Imām ash-Shāfiʿī: knowledge is that which benefits
fields.body:
🖋️ **Imām ash-Shāfiʿī** said:

> ***“Imām ash-Shāfiʿī said in meaning: Knowledge is not that which is memorized; rather, knowledge is that which benefits.”***

🌙 **Conclusion:** Knowledge shows its worth through fear of Allah, action, and correction of the heart — not only through the quantity of terms.

immutable.source: 📝 Abū Nuʿaym, Ḥilyat al-Awliyāʾ; adh-Dhahabī, Siyar Aʿlām an-Nubalāʾ, biographische Überlieferungen von ash-Shāfiʿī.
